title: 竜の目はまだ
subject: A shy accounting clerk who hand-embroiders a dragon on the back of a plain black jacket at his low table every night, one scale an evening, and keeps leaving the eye unstitched because a finished jacket would have to be worn outside.
caption: Japanese chūka-fū oriental pop-rock, fast Chinese-flavoured band sound. Soaring erhu lead sliding between vocal phrases, fast plucked guzheng pentatonic runs and glissandi, trilled dizi bamboo flute fills at section ends, overdriven electric guitar with tight palm-muted eighth-note riffs, live drum kit with four-on-the-floor verses and crashing backbeat choruses. Bright, punchy live-band mix with the voice upfront. Male lead, bright tenor, energetic full voice, melody clearly sung with crisp consonants. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 152 BPM, D minor. Dashing, sly, mock-heroic. No rap, no autotune, no EDM synths, no trap hi-hats, no whispering.

[Outro - dizi trill, erhu slide, guitar riff]
